title: The Monster Leiska
text: “One Filolial per person, you say… Seriously, I guess that means I’m ‘Filo’?”
“Well, Filo-tan is the supreme being who presides over love, after all. That includes my Father, my Finacée, and me—we’re all Filolial-sama.”
“You’re talking nonsense… I’m pretty sure my Finacée was Melty… So does that mean I don’t have one either, just like Sadeena? Well, that’s a relief.”
Oh? For some reason, my Father seems relieved. That’s a mistake. My father-in-law is a man beloved by all the Filolial-sama. And on top of that, he has Filo-tan’s love as well.
“Raph”

Oh? That’s Raph—a creature created in my mind based on the hair of the Big Sister my father-in-law imagined… Ah, a member of the Raph species is rolling around, making its presence known. They were on good terms with the Filolial-sama, weren’t they? It’s striking how well they got along with my Father, too. And since Kou had married a Rough-species woman, that made it all the more so.
“Rafu”

With a pop, the Rough-species creature in my mind vanished like smoke. It’s as elusive as my Big Sister. Anyway, while I was raising the Filolial-sama, on the third day of our stay on the island… it was decided that I would swap companions with Itsuki.
“Itsuki should be coming today. He might try to gloss over things, go easy on you, or brag, but you mustn’t pester him with questions.”
“Understood.”

Yuki-chan wasn’t used to it at first, but she’s gradually gotten the hang of taking care of the newly hatched Filolial-sama. She can be a bit too strict with herself, but she’s starting to show the same thoughtfulness and leadership that I know Yuki-chan is capable of. Since I left Kou with Big Sister, he’s already out of my party and is now part of Father’s party. He looked like he was enjoying being petted by Big Sister. Since Filo-tan was glued to Father, I don’t think she’s jealous… she seems to be fine.
So, I headed straight for Itsuki’s room. I gave the door a light knock.
“Hellooo!”
And out came Fleon-chan.
“Oh, Motoyasu-san, I heard we’re supposed to be bonding from today through tomorrow!”
“Bueeeh…”
“That’s right.”

The stalker pig is inside too… and for some reason, he’s wearing a Risuka costume. Come to think of it, he was wearing it in the first world as well. Apparently, she was wearing it because she’d been ostracized by her friends back then. The Smoked Meat characters aren’t here in this world anymore, so why is she wearing it?
“What happened to that?”

“Oh, I was talking with Itsuki-san about having Rishia-san wear a costume soon, and she said that one was good, so she’s wearing it. My sense of justice does tell me it’s not a bad idea to have someone in that kind of role, but what do you think, Motoyasu-san?”
“I’m not really sure.”
Why on earth is that stalker pig wearing that outfit?
“Bueh!? Bueh, bueh, bueh!”
“Fleon-chan, what on earth is this guy saying?”
“Huh? Motoyasu-san, don’t you get it? Rishia-san is saying to you, ‘Fueh!? P-Please turn Itsuki-sama back to normal!’”
Hmm… If he’s returned to normal, that stalker pig will just be discarded as useless around this island, won’t he? What’s his motive, I wonder?
“Motoyasu, don’t you even understand what Rishia is saying?”
“Exactly. This fellow is a stalker pig, after all. Pigs will follow you around if things don’t go their way, and they’ll try to kill you at the first opportunity.”
The events surrounding my summoning to this other world really left an impression on me. There’s nothing more selfish and troublesome than a deranged pig.
“You mean Rishia?”
Fleon-chan tilts her head slightly as she looks at the stalker pig in his costume.

“Motoyasu-san, that’s a misunderstanding. The Rishia you know was likely trying to protect Itsuki-san and uncover the truth. After all, Itsuki-san was probably being manipulated and exploited by those people.”

“Those people” refers to Smoked Meat and the rest of that crew, doesn’t it? In this loop, they belonged to the Three Heroes Church and were blown up along with them. Hmm… Indeed, based on my previous loops, the stalker pig didn’t really seem to exhibit the behavior of a deranged pig. Above all, there’s what Fleon-chan said. Maybe I’m just mistaken.

But… u-uh, my memories from my very first loop… the memory of my Father saying that the Stalker Pig was targeting me is coming back! Though, maybe that was just my Father’s way of joking… and then there’s what Fleon-chan said… uuugh, which one is the truth?!
“Feeee…”
“Oh? You’re not speaking Pig-speak anymore. So you’re no longer a pig, then.”
“W-what are you talking about… Itsuki-sama…”
“Hmm, the stalker pig, now known as Lee… Skar, was it?”
“N-no, that’s not it! Feeee…”
Leeskar is shaking her head vigorously for some reason.
“Agent Leeskar, is it…? Not a bad hero name. As someone in a support role for our team, it might be easy for everyone to remember. Let’s report this to Itsuki-san.”
“Feeee…”
Fleon-chan nodded repeatedly, as if she were convinced. I suppose that wraps up the introductions.
“Anyway, let’s head out on the hunt!”
“Yes! O-okay, Agent Leiska, let’s go.”
“I told you, that’s not my name!”
“You become Leiska when you’re in that form! It’s a transformation!”
“Waaah…”
And just then, Leiska took off the costume… and a pig popped out.
“Oink, oink, oink.”
“You’re supposed to speak human language. Why have you turned into a pig?”

It’s just like Keel. No, surely, just like Keel, her Risuuka form was the result of the curse being lifted. From now on, whenever Risuuka’s costume goes missing, I’ll make her a new one. That way, the curse will be lifted.
“Ooohhh!”
The cursed Leiska let out a scream, but in the end, it seems she decided to wear the Risuka costume after all. And so, together with Fleon-chan, we set out on a hunting trip with Leiska.
“Fleon-chan, Leiska is a late bloomer. I hear she’ll have a sudden growth spurt right around the time she crosses Level 80. Her growth from that point on is supposed to be incredible.”
“Whoa! Is that so! So, thanks to all your hard work, you have what it takes to become a true hero! You’re a hero through and through!”
I think I saw a fire ignite in Fleon-chan’s eyes.
“You also have a natural talent for working with the concept of ‘Ki.’ Since the advisor will be giving you lessons later, your potential for growth is limitless.”
“Waaah… I feel like I’m going to get modified or something…”
“Furthermore, you’re highly capable as a strategist, with considerable knowledge of regional languages and folklore, so you’re sure to become a reliable subordinate!”
“Exactly! I’m getting a good vibe from you, too! Leiska! Let’s go!”
“Let’s go!”
“Feeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee!”
And so, we climbed onto Fleon-chan’s back and charged straight toward the hunting grounds!
“Aiming Lancer X! Brionac X! Gungnir X! Liberation Firestorm X! Liberation Prominence X! Liberation Fire Eye X! Hahaha! Weak! Way too weak!”
That was a fun hunt with Fleon-chan! A carpet bombing from the sky!
“Let’s go, go! Oh, are there any bosses that grow giant?”
“There aren’t any on Cal Mira Island. But there might be monsters disguised as humans.”
Like Rival or the guys from Takt’s group—that sort of thing.
“This is getting intense! Filolial Mask No. 2 Kick!”

Fleon-chan took down the island’s boss in one hit with a kick after a nosedive. I sensed her attack, grabbed Leiska, and glided away in Flying Mode. Then, I hopped onto Fleon-chan’s back as she returned and struck a victory pose.
“Whaaaaaat!? I’m spinning around! Itsuki-samaaaaaaa!”

And so, the hunting to train Leiska went smoothly. At least it wasn’t as much of a hassle as hunting with the Smoked Meats. It certainly seems that Leiska—formerly known as the Stalker Pig—is, without a doubt, one of Itsuki’s capable subordinates. And just like that, the day’s hunt came to an end.
The next day, when I returned to the inn on the main island… my Father was having a rather troubled conversation with my Big Sister and Ren’s companions.
“Fueeeee…”
Leiska is sitting there, looking as if she’s about to pass out. I leave Leiska in Fleon-chan’s care and approach my Father and the others. Oh no! Eeeeeek… It’s Filo-tan!
“Ah, it’s the Spear Guy! How lovely!”
“Greetings!”
Acting on instinct, I offered Filo-tan the gummy I’d been making with my spear.
“Are you hungry?”
“Are you giving me more?”
“Of course. Aren’t you hungry?”
“Hmm… I’m not really hungry yet, but I’ll eat it.”
“Here you go.”
“Yay!”
After taking the gummy from me, Filo-tan kindly cleared the way for me. So I headed straight over to my Father.
“What’s the matter?”
“Ah, Motoyasu… Including Ren’s friends, I ended up having to listen to Raphtalia’s complaints about how she’s tired of Ren and Black Thunder’s constant bickering.”
“I never imagined there could be someone even more of a handful than the Spear Hero… I had a hunch, but I never expected it.”
My Big Sister says this, sounding exhausted.
“Raphtalia, you’re putting too much pressure on yourself.”
“How do you and Naofumi-sama manage to get along with those people, Sadeena-nee?”
Oh, so my Big Sister’s older sister has been acting as a buffer between Ren and Black Thunder.
“Are Ren’s companions also coming to my Father for advice?”
“More like… they’ve come to me with this troublesome request to help Ren under my supervision. Apparently, these past two days have been that comfortable for them.”
They’re having a rather baffling discussion, aren’t they? That said, judging by the example of the village slaves, I think my Father will be able to handle Ren’s companions as well.

“The battle on Cal Mira Island with the Shield Hero was very pleasant. As for the Sword Hero, before he met that Filolial who goes by the name ‘Black Thunder,’ I thought he was someone who, though clumsy, could be of help, but lately, I’ve been finding it harder and harder to make sense of what he’s saying…”

Hmm… These fellows are Ren’s subordinates, hired by the kingdom. Depending on the situation, they might already be dead somewhere. I suppose you could say they’re harmless. Still, I do recall we destroyed them all when we went to Faubrey together.
“Hey, Motoyasu, you’re partly to blame for this, so give us a hand.”
“You mean dealing with Ren?”

He swings his spear back and forth with a swish-swish sound. At least during the battle with the Pope, Ren seemed to understand the concept of shared enhancement, didn’t he? That’s thanks to Black Thunder teaching him Ren’s method of awakening.
“Dealing with him… It looks like the Spear Hero is about to stab the Sword Hero to death…”
“If my Father wants it, I’m sorry to Black Thunder, but I guess I could do it?”
“Don’t just casually say something so outrageous.”

Well, personally, I don’t really care much about Ren as long as Black Thunder is around, but since my Father thinks he’s necessary, there’s no need to finish him off. Actually, he’s harmless now compared to how he was in the first world.
“Getting back to the topic at hand—the issue with Ren… How exactly did he cause you trouble, Big Sister?”

“Um… The Sword Hero was watching the fight between me and Filo, and he told me to use Magic to hide myself and take down the monster in one blow. That part was fine, but after I defeated the enemy, he made me turn my back, say ‘Illusion Kill,’ and strike a pose—he lectured me on that for ages…”
“You went along with it for a while, but you got tired of it, didn’t you?”
“Yes… With the monster that seemed to be the island’s lord, once Filo drew its attention, the Sword Hero and I took it down just as we’d planned…”
Hmm, Ren is usually bad at teamwork, but he’s managing to fight alongside his Big Sister without any issues.
“In my Big Sister’s case, whenever she unleashed a technique, Ren-chan looked like he was having a blast.”
“What can Sadeena do, anyway?”
“My Big Sister is a master of lightning Magic.”
Of course, she’s also quite skilled in martial arts. She’s quite the multi-talented person.

“Ah… I bet those guys would be thrilled by that. I mean, ‘Black Thunder’ even has ‘Thunder’ in its name—so Sadeena, cloaked in lightning, would be something to get excited about… Though whether a drunken orca is cool is another matter… No, maybe the fact that he’s usually goofing around but becomes dependable when it counts is something they can relate to?”
My father started muttering to himself as he analyzed Ren.
